title: Maria Holic Gets Sequel Series After 12 Years
content: Minari Endo announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Tuesday a new sequel series for her Maria Holic manga titled Maria Holic : Sono Ato no 12-kagetsu no Ohanashi ( Maria Holic : A Story Set 12 Months After) will launch in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine on August 27.
author: ANN

title: Five Years Later, Jujutsu Kaisen’s Biggest Anime Installment Is About to Become Even Easier to Watch
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is one of the most popular anime of the modern generation, and so far, the anime has received three seasons and a movie. However, the anime’s availability across streaming platforms has also been a concern, especially with Crunchyroll being dominant among anime fans.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Game's Trailer Previews Weapons Bosses
content: Square Enix revealed during this year's gamescom Opening Night Live event on Tuesday a trailer for Final Fantasy VII Revelation , the third and final game in the Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy, and it previews the Weapons bosses: Ruby Weapon, Emerald Weapon, and Ultima Weapon.
author: ANN

title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour Game's Trailer Previews Multiplayer
content: Sega unveiled during this year's gamescom Opening Night Live event on Tuesday a trailer for Crazy Taxi: World Tour , a new entry in its racing game series, and it previews the game's multiplayer. The game will launch for Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC via Steam and Microsoft Store in 2027.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia Creator’s Latest Manga Is a Massive Hit Even Weeks After Its Debut
content: Written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi, My Hero Academia is one of the most successful anime and manga franchises of all time. The manga began serialization in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2014 before Studio Bones released an anime adaptation two years later.

title: Crunchyroll Enlists James Gunn And Guillermo Del Toro For Major Anime Event
content: Anime is becoming a big deal these days for Hollywood, with the box office receipts to prove it. Anime films such as Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle, Spirited Away , and too many other movies to count have hit it big in the West.

title: Mega Man: Dual Override Game's Trailer Reveals Twinkle Girl, Protoman
content: CAPCOM unveiled a new trailer during this year's gamescom Opening Night Live event on Tuesday for Mega Man: Dual Override , a new game in its Mega Man series, and it introduces the new character Twinkle Girl as well as returning character Protoman.
